test.title: Something you do regularly to help protect the environment

document.cue: Describe something you do regularly to help protect the environment.

text: Something I do regularly is sort my rubbish for recycling. It sounds like a small thing, but where I live it actually takes a bit of effort, because the recycling containers are at the other end of the street, and it's often easier just to throw everything into one bin.

I started about three years ago, after a volunteer came to our university and showed us photos of the landfill outside our city. I was honestly shocked by how much plastic was there, and I decided I'd at least stop adding to it.

Now I keep three bags in the kitchen — one for plastic, one for paper and one for glass. Every Sunday I take them to the containers on my way to the shop, which only takes about ten minutes. At first my family found it annoying, especially my dad, who kept throwing bottles into the wrong bag, but after a few months it became completely normal for everyone.

I think it matters because small habits add up. One person's recycling won't change much, but if millions of people do the same, it makes a real difference, and it also puts pressure on companies to use less packaging in the first place.
So it's a minor inconvenience, really, compared to the problem it helps to solve.

tips.en: After a volunteer came to our university answers “when you started” with a concrete trigger.
tips.kk: After a volunteer came to our university — нақты себеп «қашан бастадыңыз» дегенге жауап береді.
tips.ru: After a volunteer came to our university — конкретный повод отвечает на «когда начали».

note.en: What the speaker does — and straight away, honestly: a small thing that takes effort.

note.ru: Что делает — и сразу честно: «мелочь, но требует усилий».

note.en: When it started — with the trigger: photos of the landfill.
note.kk: Қашан бастады — себебімен: қоқыс полигонының суреттері.
note.ru: Когда начал — с поводом: фото свалки.

note.en: How easy or difficult — step by step, with the family’s reaction.
note.kk: Оңай ма, қиын ба — қадаммен және отбасының реакциясымен.
note.ru: Легко или трудно — по шагам и с реакцией семьи.

note.en: Why it matters — from one person to millions and then to companies.
note.kk: Неге маңызды — бір адамнан миллиондарға және компанияларға дейін.
note.ru: Почему важно — от одного человека к миллионам и к компаниям.

note.en: The ending weighs the inconvenience against the benefit.
